newsitem.title: USA: Marathon Oil wins $78.2 mln judgment vs U.S. gov't.
newsitem.headline: Marathon Oil wins $78.2 mln judgment vs U.S. gov't.

text.p: Marathon Oil Co, part of USX Corp's USX-Marathon Group, said on Monday that the U.S. Court of Federal Claims has entered a $78.2 million judgment in its favor and against the federal government.

It said that under a recently-issued ruling, the court ordered the U.S. government to return to Marathon bonus monies that the company paid to obtain an interest in five offshore leases in North Carolina.
Marathon said the Department of Justice has indicated it will appeal the ruling and that an appeal may be made as early as mid-1998.
Marathon said it and a co-venturer paid more than $156 million to acquire the five leases.

But the court has determined that the passage of the Outer Banks Protection Act blocked access to the traces and disrupted rights to explore and procure hydrocarbons from the underlying geological prospects.
That, it said in its suit filed in May 1992, violated its and its partner's lease rights.
